jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3–6 years in a client-facing, technical delivery role (implementation, deployment, solutions engineering, or technical customer success) Experience that maps to at least one: delivery/deployment lead shipping AI or data products into production for enterprise clients; solutions engineer or technical PM moving toward the client/business side; strategy/process consultant who owns outcomes rather than only handing off recommendations Comfort with ambiguity and technical depth, including the ability to work hands-on with flow logic, JSON configurations, and prompt structure
